fixes.found_by: founder, phone walk of items 2-8 (step 27 — campaign → set → posting date)
fixes.defect: The brand app force-closed the instant the posting-date calendar drew. DateField.blocked() returned max (null), not false, for every choosable day whenever no maxDate was given — which is every posting-date picker. The null reached the day cell as accessibilityState.disabled, and Android BaseViewManager.setViewState reads it with hasKey("disabled") && getBoolean("disabled"): hasKey is true for a null-valued key and getBoolean throws NoSuchKeyException. Uncatchable native crash.
fixes.blast_radius: Every DateField in both apps: brand set posting date, offer start/end, special-offer dates; creator "ask to move the date" (item 6) and pitch date (item 8).
fixes.fix: blocked/prevBlocked/nextBlocked return real booleans; the eight other accessibilityState literals in the two apps coerced with !! for the same reason.
guards: Packages/Mobile/src/components/__tests__/dateField.test.js (opens the picker, asserts every day cell is a boolean — validated by reverting the fix)
Packages/Mobile/src/__tests__/accessibilityStateBooleans.test.js (static scan of the whole mobile tree)
fixes.why_no_test_caught_it: There is no native side under node, so the calendar renders happily in jest while the device dies.
fixes.classification: production-impacting — mobile JS only; OTA brand + influencer. No backend, no migration, no website.
